cases.title: Indefinite-length array of 1, 2 then break
cases.paragraph: An indefinite-length array is a head with additional information 31, then data items, then the break stop code 0xff.

cases.title: Major type 0 with ai=24 but no following byte is not well-formed
cases.paragraph: Additional information 24 means one extra byte follows. A missing extra byte is not a well-formed data item.

cases.title: A break code is not a data item by itself
cases.paragraph: The break stop code 0xff ends an indefinite-length item; it is not itself a value.
